features.title: Document Block Model, Persistence & Basic Blocks Panel Insertion
features.description: Add EditorBlock.MermaidBlock(id, code, title) to NoteDocument.kt with backward-compatible JSON serialization (type: 'mermaid'), auto-save integration in NoteEditorViewModel, 'Mermaid Diagram' tile addition to BasicBlocksPanel.kt, and Markdown/PDF export formatting in NoteExporter.kt.
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can open the Basic Blocks panel, tap the Mermaid Diagram tile to insert a starter flowchart block, and see changes saved across note reloads and exported to Markdown.
features.notes: Foundational block model and persistence; visual verification is owned by final slice US-4.

features.title: Local Offline Mermaid Rendering Engine & Theme Synchronization
features.description: Implement the on-device MermaidRenderer backed by local WebView and bundled mermaid.min.js asset. Evaluates Mermaid DSL offline without network requests, injects AppColors light/dark theme tokens, generates SVG strings, and returns structured error states for syntax errors.
features.user_visible_behavior: Mermaid DSL code renders locally as a high-quality SVG diagram with theme-matched colors, and invalid code produces an inline syntax alert without crashing.
features.notes: Core offline rendering engine; intermediate UI slice.

features.title: Mermaid Diagram Card with Mode Toggle & Quick Template Chips
features.description: Implement MermaidBlockCard Compose component in NoteEditorScreen. Includes elevated card layout (#FFFFFF surface, #E7E3F6 border), diagram title editing, 'Edit Code' / 'View Chart' mode toggle button, template chips ('Flowchart', 'Sequence', 'Class', 'State'), monospace code editor, inline pinch-to-zoom/pan viewport, and read-only protection.
features.user_visible_behavior: Mermaid block defaults to diagram preview mode. Tapping 'Edit Code' reveals code editor with template chips. Tapping template inserts starter boilerplate. Diagram can be pinched to zoom inline.
features.notes: Card-level interaction and editing; visual verification is owned by final slice US-4.

features.title: Fullscreen Interactive Diagram Viewer & Visual Verification
features.description: Implement FullscreenDiagramViewerDialog reachable via expand action on Mermaid card header. Provides edge-to-edge canvas with pan/zoom (50%-400%), floating zoom controls (+, -, 100%, Fit to Screen), code copy to clipboard, and SVG sharing/export. Owns the final visual verification contract and screenshot captures.
features.user_visible_behavior: Tapping expand icon opens full-screen diagram viewer with pan/zoom navigation, zoom level buttons, code copy, and SVG sharing.
